current.headline: The AI opportunity gap is opening now.

current.headline: AI opportunity is growing. Access to it is not growing evenly.
current.summary: Read this week in order: first, who is getting the opportunity; second, how ordinary work is changing; third, what new privacy, permission and provenance questions come with it. Then choose one repeatable workflow to practise—not six new tools to sample.
